common.theme: Dark sci-fi with neons (owner decision). Neon only on edges, rim, lines, veins, towers; never on cell centres. Red reserved for danger. Steady, no flicker. Overrides world.md 'no emissive' and 'nothing saturated'.

A.name: Circuit Slab
A.idea: Tally's ledger wiring runs through the dead moon's slag-glass: cyan and violet circuit lines trace every cell edge and the rim, as if the books were still being counted.
A.neon_carried_by: cell edges (1 px lines in the gap), rim channel, and circuit traces running across the ground to the horizon

A.sky: Black, ~500 stars in 3 brightness steps, a slow violet nebula band low on the horizon (#2a1d55, soft, static), a small pale planet (8 deg, #9fb0c8) high right giving a cool rim.

sun.intensity: hard small disc, ~3.5, cool white; neon lines add local bounce

A.arena: Cells: slate glass with fine internal grain and a lit 2 px bevel; edge = 1 px cyan line in the dark gap, glow bloom limited to 3 px so cells stay clean. Rim: dark plate with a continuous violet channel. Ground: slag plate with a PCB-like grid of 1 px circuit traces (right-angle, 45 degree jogs, node pads) in dim violet/cyan, over regolith grain and fine cracks.
A.world: Terrain: stepped terraces with strata, circuit traces crossing them. Outcrops: faceted dark glass blocks with cyan edge lines. Towers: thin spires with a violet lamp ring. Walls: low plates with a glowing seam.
A.neon_checks: neon lines sit in the gap, not on cell tops, so the ratios above are not affected

B.name: Crystal Vein
B.idea: Slag-glass remembers heat: in this view it has grown into living crystal veins that glow acid-green and blue-teal, the warmth of the crew still stored in the rock.
B.neon_carried_by: crystal veins in the ground and outcrops, vein cracks along the rim, crystal clusters as towers

B.sky: Black, ~450 stars, a large ringless planet (22 deg, deep blue #1c3a6a with a thin lit crescent) low left; a faint static green glow band at the horizon.

sun.intensity: hard, ~3.2; green and blue crystal light as fill, shadows keep a visible floor

B.arena: Cells: polished mineral with faceted micro-relief (Voronoi normal, 1 px), edges thin green vein line in the gap; no neon on centres. Rim: dark crystal plate, vein cracks branching along it (Voronoi edges, steady emissive). Ground: mineral dust plus crystal shards (small bright prisms, specular) and branching vein cracks fading with distance.
B.world: Terrain: faceted mineral ridges with vein cracks glowing on slopes. Outcrops: crystal clusters, green core and blue tips. Towers: tall crystal spires. Walls: jagged crystal ridges with a lit seam.
B.neon_checks: neon lines sit in the gap, not on cell tops, so the ratios above are not affected

C.name: Signal Hull
C.idea: CSV Ballast at 11 % power: its last signal lights, amber and electric blue, run along the board rim and gantry towers while the hull looms overhead.
C.neon_carried_by: rim light strips, gantry tower beacons, runway-style marker lines on the ground, hull running lights in the sky

C.sky: Black, ~350 stars. The Ballast hull fills the top third: dark steel with panel lines, 6 steady amber running lights, 3 blue beacons, one cold flood lamp. A thin crescent of Hollow behind.

sun.intensity: hard flood lamp ~5.0, cold white; amber strips as warm accent fill

C.arena: Cells: brushed steel (anisotropic streaks along one axis), engraved rim, light rivets; edge = faint blue line in the gap. Rim: riveted girder with a continuous amber strip. Ground: dock apron of 2 m plates, seams, oil stains, dashed amber and blue marker lines pointing to the board.
C.world: Terrain: dark plain with floodlit pools, rim-lit ridges. Outcrops: ore heaps with slag crust. Towers: gantry masts with amber and blue beacons. Walls: stacked cargo containers with edge strips.
C.neon_checks: neon lines sit in the gap, not on cell tops, so the ratios above are not affected

recommendation.reason: A: cyan and violet circuit lines on a lit slate slab give the most legible neon edges and the clearest 'Tally ledger' lore link; contrast passes (cell vs gap 3.54, black marble 3.32, white marble 4.79). Risk: cyan edge is the same hue family as the player accent, so keep the edge a 1 px line and the turn rim thick. C has the best raw contrast (3.95 / 3.70 / 4.29) and is the closest to the existing industrial look; B is the most alien but its green may clash with the Okabe-Ito tints.
recommendation.note: Computed from hexes only (WCAG), nothing rendered; real renders may shift values.
